features.text: THUMB SPICA IMMOBILIZATION: Stabilizes the thumb and wrist for sprains, tendonitis, and post-cast support.
QUICK-LACER EASE: One-pull system tightens evenly for fast, consistent application.
CUSTOMIZABLE STAYS: Malleable stays let you fine-tune wrist and thumb positioning.
SOFT, BREATHABLE MATERIALS: Comfortable for day or night wear under clothing.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
